intro.text: A beggar who made his home in an alley of Kasitor.

items.text: One morning the beggar found Axies the Collector lying naked and beaten in his alley, and demanded rent. He blamed the Aimian for flattening a temple, a bakery, several houses and half a street of his little city in the fall, and asked whether he was a Herald or a Voidbringer. Axies got a blanket out of him by hinting that the holy cloth would drive its owner from the alley.

appearance.text: A man with a straggly beard and missing teeth, dressed in a sack meant for lavis.

personality.text: He lived among rubbish and rotting vegetables and boasted that his alley was the best in town. He laid the vegetables out as a tiny city and ruled it like a god, complaining that some of its imaginary people had been misbehaving.
